heading: 4. Declaration system
text:
## 4. Declaration system [LUNI.4]

All unit-system declarations begin with the `unit` keyword:

```
unit_decl ::= unit_dimension      # [LUNI.4.1] a physical dimension
           |  unit_scalar         # [LUNI.4.2] a dimensionless scalar group
           |  unit_symbol         # [LUNI.4.3] a unit within a dimension or group
           |  unit_formula        # [LUNI.4.5] a cross-dimension formula pair
           |  unit_fx_pair        # [LUNI.4.6] a runtime-rate currency conversion
```

**Residue the grammar does not carry:** the second token selects the form. One
of [LUNI.4.4]'s four form words — `dimension`, `scalar`, `formula`, `fx_pair` —
selects its form when no `:` follows it. Any other second token, or a form word
followed by `:`, begins a `unit_symbol`.
